title: Honey and Clover
native: ハチミツとクローバー
synopsis:
Takemoto Yuuta, Mayama Takumi, and Morita Shinobu are college students who share the small apartment. Even though they live in poverty, the three of them are able to obtain pleasure through small things in life. The story follows these characters' life stories as poor college students, as well as their love lives when a short but talented 18 year old girl called Hanamoto Hagumi appears.

(Source: Anime News Network)
search_text: honey and clover ハチミツとクローハ ー tv finished

episodes.title: The Day It All Began
episodes.synopsis: An unusual transfer student arrives at the art school Takemoto attends and attracts the attention of Morita, causing him to go on a photo-taking spree on her. Mayama, Takemoto and Yamada soon discover her artistic talents.

episodes.title: The two affections start to turn
episodes.synopsis: Morita's motive for his terrible treatment on Hagumi is revealed in his website, and the stressed out Hagumi is enraged by what but he did. However, Morita soon repays her for her troubles.

episodes.title: These were two unrequited loves
episodes.synopsis:
Takemoto, Morita and Mayama are invited over to the Hanamoto's for a dinner party after Hagumi brings back some soba from her summer vacation in Nagano. However, Morita and Mayama fail to attend.  Takemoto offers to help Hagumi with something but soon finds that he has taken on more than he can chew.
And Mayama's job puts a serious strain on Yamada.

episodes.title: The boy and girl are swayed
episodes.synopsis: Mayama's love life still remains difficult. Hagumi feels the stress of being different from everyone. And Morita organises a Christmas party for the Christmas Eve.

episodes.title: I think of my mother in my hometown
episodes.synopsis:
Takemoto reluctantly returns home for the New Year and meets Kazuo, his step-father.
In the second part of the episode, the gang takes a road trip to a hot spring using the money won from a lottery ticket.

episodes.title: The past, the tears, the confession
episodes.synopsis: The group visits a rather eerie zoo. Shuuji reveals to Mayamoto his history with Rika and her husband.  In the second half of the episode, the students are hard pressed to complete their final term art work especially Morita.

episodes.title: We Look for a Miracle
episodes.synopsis:
Shuuji Hanamoto has to be away for a year for a job assignment and he worries about whether he should bring his niece, Hagumi, along with him.
Intending to give her uncle a good luck charm for his trip, Hagumi searches for a four-leaf clover.

episodes.title: Because I Can't Leave You Alone
episodes.synopsis: Hagumi and Ayama hold a dinner party and invite the guys over but it soon turns out that it's a special day for one of them. And in the second part of the episode, Hagumi has to spend a night alone in the apartment when Ayama has to return home to her family.

episodes.title: That brooch was so heavy
episodes.synopsis: Everyone is working late preparing their exhibits for the school festival including Hagumi, who has trouble with her wax work. She later finds a white broach that someone had made for her. The broach is quite similar to the one she had doodled on her notebook. Hagumi also gets a job to help Yamada sell Christmas goodies at her family store but they have to compete with a new supermarket that has opened nearby.

episodes.title: We Fly Across the Sky
episodes.synopsis: The five friends decide to take a ferry ride over the Sumida river and visit the Kasai Seaside Park.

episodes.title: Love pushes us around
episodes.synopsis: Shuuji returns unexpectedly from Mongolia. And Hagumi goes on a shopping trip with Morita.

episodes.title: The sudden kiss, the unexpected parting
episodes.synopsis: It's the sakura season and the gang are absorbed in the array of activities celebrating the sakura festival.  Hagumi catches one of her wisdom fevers. And Takemoto meets Morita's brother, Kaoru, and learns of news regarding Morita.

episodes.title: All I wanted to hear was that little thing
episodes.synopsis: The episode starts with Takamoto feelings about what he wanted Hagu to answer for her wanting Morita to come back or not. But her stern and straight forward answer before was really hurt him. The story mainly talked about Yamada and her feelings later on. To save money, Mayama asked Yamada to help making some cases for his firm's project. This fact connected her to his work and helped the story develop.

episodes.title: I touched her in my dream
episodes.synopsis: Mayama dreamed of Rika-san. His co-worker said when one dreamed of another, that was because the person in the dream wanted them to meet so much that the soul escaped the body and came to the dream. Mayama was doubt about that but on the way came back from a conference, he and his co-workers passed a park where Rika-san was just behind a fountain watching him passing by. Mayama didn't notice until later on. But when he ran back to the fountain, she was not there anymore.

episodes.title: My cowardly self starts running
episodes.synopsis: Mayama's work is going well, but he still misses Rika-san. Her current assistant suddenly has health problem and needs to stay in hospital. Mayama meets Rika-san in hospital and asks her if he can come back, but she rejected. Nomiya at the same time wants to meet Yamada and really gets his eyes on her. Mayama tried to protect Yamada from him (much like a mother) as he says he wants her to meet a guy who treasures and don't just hook her up for fun. Takamoto was searching for jobs and doing his final project, which later on was given name by Hanamoto-sensei. This name made the idea become clear and his work masterpiece.

episodes.title: The moon is calling her
episodes.synopsis: The firm Mayama was about to be apart. For some intentional purpose, his boss put him into the group of people who have to leave Tokyo to another place. At the same time, Rika-san's assistant was is hospital and she hasn't been able to find a replacement. Hence, Mayama decided to leave the firm and came back to work for Rika-san, without much of asking for her permission. Yamada acknowledged about this through Nomiya (Mayama's boss) and she was really depressed after that. After that, she was proposed by four guys from the shopping arcane (they were friends since small) but she ran away. Hanamoto-sensei later on explained for her that the situation of her and Mayama was similar and in that case (loving someone who doesn't love you), people could just choose either "make some effort or give it up" and advised her to tell those guys her true feelings. After Yamada left, Hanamoto-sensei's thinking revealed that there is a third choice, but he would never speak it out.

episodes.title: I don't even know how I feel
episodes.synopsis: Yuta’s awkward communication skills cause him trouble during job interviews. It also seems that he hasn’t been able to choose one thing to commit himself to. Hagumi continues to worry about him.

episodes.title: He came back
episodes.synopsis: Yuta and friends are shocked when they see Shinobu on TV! He is giving a speech at the Mocademy Awards in Hollywood. They are even more surprised when they learn he has come back to Japan without telling them.

episodes.title: Time begins to move again
episodes.synopsis: On his first new project, Takumi must collaborate Fujiwara Design Office – the design company where he just resigned.  When he visits the office for a meeting, he is surprised to run into Ayumi.

episodes.title: I pray to the moon hovering in the night sky
episodes.synopsis: Even though Yuta is staying another year at college, he hasn’t decided what he wants to do yet. Hagumi says she will keep painting after she graduates.  When Yuta hears this, he is even more disappointed by his lack of decisiveness.

episodes.title: I've always been scared
episodes.synopsis: The mercurial twin presidents of Fujiwara Design Office make up with one another. Their reunion means Nomiya has to go to Tottori on business.  He goes without letting Yamada know.

episodes.title: Like a flower getting wet in the rain
episodes.synopsis: It’s been almost a week since Yuta left on bicycle without any direction. Although he has still not found his reason, he keeps heading north picking up supplies at a dollar store and asking local residents for water.

episodes.title: And so, I begin to run
episodes.synopsis: Even though Yuta has started working under the restoration group, he is useless when it comes to practical work. He manages however, to prepare meals so perfectly that the group is impressed.

episodes.title: We're a Continuously Spinning Ferris Wheel
episodes.synopsis: Yuta begins to travel by bike again. The people he meets along the way, scenery he sees for the first time in his life, new experiences and even the many difficulties he encounters make him think differently about his life...
